name: form-field-find-replace
description: Firefox MV3 extension: find and replace text across editable form fields.

scripts.build:xpi: npx --yes web-ext build --overwrite-dest && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),v=require('./manifest.json').version,d='web-ext-artifacts';const f=fs.readdirSync(d).find(x=>x.endsWith('-'+v+'.zip'));if(!f)throw new Error('no build output for manifest version '+v);fs.copyFileSync(d+'/'+f,d+'/ffr.xpi');console.log('ffr.xpi <- '+f)"
